purpose: test whether frozen clause-kind probabilities become action relevant when composed with public mention incidence and explicit assignment state
runtime_inputs: public entity_mentions and role_mentions sets per clause
runtime_operation: apply frozen six-way identity head per H_j; for each affected clause compute before/after satisfaction delta under each candidate clause kind; sum probability-weighted deltas and emit the sign

clause_semantics.fixed_and_forbidden_role: one public entity ID and one public role ID
clause_semantics.exactly_one_role: public entity ID set and one public role ID
clause_semantics.implies_not_role: two entity IDs and two role IDs; average both possible pairings because the current public incidence stores sets without argument pairing

offline_diagnostics: score against private exact action labels
private-kind oracle plus public-incidence comparison; private kinds never enter runtime score
qualification_interpretation: adaptive engineering diagnostic on a partition already reported by earlier v01 sensor probes; not independent confirmation
source_and_label_boundary: private typed labels are scoring-only; no private AST fields enter runtime features or adapter predictions
